failure_modes: The side search consumes the core activity that funds it
Only the shortest path is followed, so the periphery is never examined
gloss: Explore the edges of your main model on time and resources paid for by something else
invariants: The core activity keeps paying for itself while the search runs
The search targets the periphery of the current model, not a replacement for it
mechanism: A system that is already being paid to pursue a core goal, through revenue, investment or a funded mandate, uses part of that activity to search its periphery for other options. Tooling, assets and skills built for the core goal are examined for other uses. The search is named after SETI listening on telescope time funded for other purposes.
